LESSON: SAMSON KILLS A LION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.4: Samson kills a Lion

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Samson kills a Lion
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does the story of Samson portray God’s power?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9

Teach
• Today’s focus: retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9” using a school example.
• Model B for “retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Samson kills a Lion.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the story of Samson portray God’s power?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• retell the story of Samson; Judges 14: 5- 9

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
